items.text_th: ขอให้เกาหลีเอาเกม playtogether กลับมาอยู่ในเซิร์ฟเดิม ขายให้คนเวียดนาม กิจกรรมก็เดิมๆ ของรางวัลก็เอามาแค่เปลี่ยนใหม่ ออเดอร์สวนมีแต่เงิน คนเวียดนามเล่นเยอะก็จริง มีแต่โปรทั้งนั้น อยากกลับมาแอปนี้ แอปนี้สะดวก ใช้งานง่าย ไม่งั้นเกมนี้คนจะค่อยๆหายไป ในบ้านเคยมี playtubeก็หายไป คุณทำดีอยู่แล้วจะขายทำไมนะ ไม่มีเพลงฟัง แทบไม่อยากเข้าบ้าน ลิขสิทธิ์ที่คุณเคยทำได้ ไปอยู่ในมือเวียดนาม หายหมดเลย
items.text_vn: Mong Hàn Quốc đưa game Play Together về lại server cũ. Bán cho người Việt rồi thì sự kiện cũ rích, phần thưởng thì chỉ lấy đồ cũ đổi mới, order vườn thì toàn ra tiền. Người Việt chơi đông thật nhưng toàn dùng hack (?). Muốn quay lại app này, app này tiện, dễ dùng. Không thì game này người chơi sẽ dần bỏ đi hết. Trong nhà từng có Playtube giờ cũng mất. Các bạn đang làm tốt sao lại bán chứ. Không có nhạc nghe, gần như chẳng muốn vào nhà. Bản quyền các bạn từng có, giờ vào tay Việt Nam thì mất sạch.
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.summary_vn: Muốn Hàn Quốc lấy lại game, chê bản VNG sự kiện cũ, mất nhạc
items.text_vn_machine: Phản hồi tiêu cực về hoạt động và tính năng trong game. Đây là tóm tắt phân loại; cần đối chiếu nguyên văn tiếng Thái.
items.text_en: I hope Korea brings Play Together back to the old server. Since it was sold to the Vietnamese, the events are stale, rewards are just old items swapped for new ones, and garden orders only give money. Lots of Vietnamese play but they all use hacks (?). I want to go back to this app, this app is convenient and easy to use. Otherwise players will slowly all leave this game. The house used to have Playtube, now it's gone too. You were doing well, why sell it? No music to listen to, I barely want to go home. The licenses you used to have are all gone now that it's in Vietnam's hands.
items.summary_en: Wants Korea to take the game back; criticizes stale VNG events and lost music.

items.text_th: อยากเล่นเกมในแอปเดิม ใส่โค้ดไม่ผ่านลิ้ง ให้เวียดนามดูแลเอากิจแต่เดิมๆมาเล่น เปลี่ยนแค่รางวัล อยากให้เกาหลีกลับมาดูแลเหมือนเดิม หากิจกรรมใหม่ๆมาเล่นบ้าง ไม่งั้นคนจะหายจากเกมไปเยอะนะ อยากให้เกมเป็นของเกาหลีทำ ปีสองปีก่อนตกปลา ทำกิจสนุกมาก หลังๆมาไม่หนุกเลย เติมของก็แพงขึ้น ใส่โค้ดก็ยาก ออเดอรก็งกเพชรมาก ยิ่งออเดอรฺสีดอกไม้ ขายคืนเกาหลีเขาไปเถอะ
items.text_vn: Muốn chơi game trên app cũ. Nhập code qua link không được. Để Việt Nam quản lý thì toàn lấy sự kiện cũ ra chơi lại, chỉ đổi phần thưởng. Muốn Hàn Quốc quay lại quản lý như trước, có thêm sự kiện mới để chơi, không thì người chơi sẽ bỏ game nhiều đấy. Muốn game do Hàn làm. Một hai năm trước câu cá, làm sự kiện vui lắm, dạo này chẳng vui gì cả. Nạp đồ thì đắt hơn, nhập code thì khó, đơn hàng thì keo kiệt kim cương quá, nhất là đơn hàng hoa. Bán lại cho Hàn đi.
items.summary_vn: Chê sự kiện lặp lại, code khó nhập, giá đắt, muốn Hàn quản lý lại.
items.text_en: I want to play on the old app. Entering codes via the link doesn't work. With Vietnam managing it, they just rerun old events and only change the rewards. I want Korea to manage it like before, with new events to play, otherwise lots of players will quit. I want the game made by Korea. A year or two ago fishing and events were so fun, lately nothing is fun. Top-ups are more expensive, codes are hard to enter, and orders are so stingy with diamonds, especially flower orders. Sell it back to Korea.
items.summary_en: Criticizes rerun events, hard code entry and high prices; wants Korea back in charge.
